terms.comment: Classically ālāriī are troops on the wings of an army (Caes. BC 1.73, Liv.); Traupman uses the word for the wing in hockey and football. Feminine ālāria.

sources: Lewis & Short: alarius · Lewis & Short: ala
Quotations marked “Lewis & Short” are given as Lewis & Short cites them, in the house spelling; they have not been checked against a modern edition.
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency (printed page numbers): pp. 48, 49, 50.
